version: V2 (updated solver: merge polish + seeds); V1 = TINY_EXACT.json (solver 6eacc900, single moves only)

conventions.budget_levels: unconstrained; q60 / q25 = per-metric quantile of the positive spends over all assignments; zero
conventions.observable_law: wires = emitted float64 vectors, identical vectors merged (drf.finite_law)
conventions.mi: plug-in MI with r clipped to [1e-9, 1 - 1e-9] (the solver / PRC definition)

notes: Classification uses the campaign call {'max_sweeps': 30, 'restarts': 2, 'perturb_moves': 16, 'seeds': 2, 'seed': 0}; s*r* columns repeat the V1 calls on the updated solver (which now always includes the merge polish).
A shortfall is a feasible local optimum of the solver neighbourhood (single moves + atom merges), not an arithmetic error, unless implementation_defects says otherwise.

The solver scores atom ids; when two atoms emit identical vectors the observable AUC* is lower than the atom-level value (E_tied_tables); the final release must be re-scored on merged emitted wires (drf.finite_law).
MI-optimal assignments can carry a higher J_auc than the AUC-optimal assignment under the same constraints.
